answer_1.quote: In this paper, we investigate the problem of identifying and answering questions with false assumptions.
answer_1.outputs: identifying whether a question contains false assumptions and generating interpretable answers by pinpointing false atomic assumptions

answer_2.quote: comparing a single gold answer to the generated one with existing metrics such as BLEU cannot effectively assess correctness

answer_4.quote: The generated interpretation is evaluated manually by checking whether it pinpoints the false assumptions. Appendix C.1 details the evaluation process.
answer_4.guideline: We manually annotate the interpretation of the atomic assumptions: which atomic assumptions are true and false.
